arguments.value: 68-year-old woman with metastatic lung cancer was admitted for symptomatic management and evaluation of new intermittent depersonalization/derealization episodes, described as feeling disconnected from her body and external reality, temporally associated with progression of a left posterior temporal brain metastasis.
